summary: Results for investigation OT-16-S0176, the TP04 pre-nomination in vitro safety battery for Tervemere Pharma AG. The 18 articles were run through the HepG2 viability screen, the bacterial mutation assay with and without S9 and the mammalian-cell micronucleus assessment. The bacterial assay is clear. The mammalian-cell signal on one analogue is flagged on the micronucleus sheet, and Tervemere replaced that analogue before nomination.

rows.v: OT-16-S0176 TP04 pre-nomination safety battery: results

comments.text: Bacterial result stands. The flag is on the mammalian side only, see the micronucleus sheet.
comments.author: Lucia Moretti

sheets.name: HepG2 viability
rows: HepG2 viability screen (ATP content), 24 h and 48 h exposure. Investigation OT-16-S0176.

sheets.name: Ames
rows: Bacterial mutation assay with and without S9. Mean revertants per plate, n=3. Fold is against the vehicle control on the same strain.
Control validity met for every strain on the day of scoring.

sheets.name: Micronucleus
rows: Mammalian-cell micronucleus assessment (TK6). Treatment 3 h with and without S9, recovery to 24 h. Percent micronucleated cells, RPD against vehicle.
Analogue flagged on the mammalian signal. Tervemere have replaced it in the nomination set; the flagged data stay in the archive.

comments.text: Second reader concurs with the flag. Do not release this sheet to the client without the QA note attached.
comments.author: Naomi Takamori
